purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules on gameplay/recovery-v1 differ from what production main deploys. The main gate must see exactly these changes and nothing else. Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

added: // r88 Chamber Men (Nik 2026-11-02, turn by turn 2026-11-03; js/chamberMen.js, js/chamberMenStep.js): once a season,
// before Roster Russian Roulette, a 7-round penalty shootout of 14 kicks: Daniel shoots and Nik keeps, then Nik shoots and
// Daniel keeps, and so on. The round record is rivalries/{rid}/chamberMenRounds/season_N. Each manager owns only his own
// pick string kicks[role]: one letter per kick (his shot on a kick he takes, his dive on a kick he keeps: L, M, R, or -
// when his own clock ran out), 14 at most (7 shots and 7 dives). A write adds exactly one letter to his own string and
// never changes what is there, and only while he is not ahead of the other manager (he sends kick n+1 only once the
// other has sent kick n), so nobody runs ahead, nothing is taken back, and the letter at place n is always his part on
// kick n. The other manager's string never moves. Scoring and the cylinders are worked out on both phones from the two
// strings; no lookup beyond the shared write authority, no list, no delete.
